entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'd like to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Got it, thank you. I see the order here for the Aero-Vent Helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's more of a preference. The helmet itself seems fine, but the color just isn't what I expected. It doesn't match my bike or jersey. The box is unopened, so it's in perfect condition.

I understand completely. Matching your gear is important. And I appreciate you keeping it in the original packaging. With a safety item like a helmet, it's best not to use it at all if you're not 100% happy with it.

Let me just check the policy. Okay, I see your delivery date was December 19th, which was 9 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days for a return. So, you are well within the window. I can go ahead and approve this for you right now.

That's great news, thank you. I was hoping it would be straightforward. Now, I know I'll have to cover the return shipping cost. Since I am planning to buy the correct color from you, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next purchase to help offset that shipping fee?

That's a reasonable question. Unfortunately, my system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for standard preference-based returns. The return approval for a full refund is the extent of what I can offer on this one. I'll email you the return label instructions right now.
Okay, I understand. It was worth asking. I appreciate you processing the return so quickly. I'll look for that email.
You're very welcome. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks again, David.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
